title: Betopia AI
desc: An internal AI ecosystem spanning an LLM API gateway, agentic harness web chat, a coding-agent CLI, and an IDE extension.
contrib: Built agent workflows, context assembly, retrieval, tool calling, and self-hosted inference infrastructure.
highlights: LangGraph agent runtime with explicit state checkpoints
Dynamic context assembled from project schema, repo tree & session
Self-hosted low-latency inference with vLLM engine

title: Firecomm AI
desc: A role-aware agentic RAG platform designed for 2,200+ enterprise users, with cited answers over 500+ operational documents.
contrib: Implemented access-scoped vector filtering, multi-query expansion, BM25 indexing, and strict citation enforcement.
highlights: Dense and BM25 hybrid search with reciprocal rank fusion
Grounded answers with direct page-level citations & confidence scores

title: Lawyer.AI
desc: A legal-domain chatbot combining document retrieval, multi-agent workflows, and citation-aware responses.
contrib: Designed hierarchical legal reasoning graphs with specialized statutory and case precedent analyzers.
highlights: Dense & sparse retrieval over statutory codes & judgments
Cross-encoder reranking to ensure case relevance
Persistent multi-turn conversation state with checkpointing

title: GRPO Reinforcement-Learning Fine-Tuning
desc: Applied Group Relative Policy Optimisation (GRPO) to align model outputs with reward signals, going beyond supervised fine-tuning toward human-preference alignment.
contrib: Implemented a full RLHF training loop in Hugging Face TRL, including reward modelling and policy-gradient optimisation.
highlights: Full RLHF training loop with Hugging Face TRL

title: Bangla Hate-Speech Classifier
desc: Fine-tuned BanglaBERT with LoRA/QLoRA (PEFT) adapters for multi-class hate-speech detection, reaching 72% accuracy.
contrib: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~60% via 4-bit quantisation (QLoRA) enabling fine-tuning on consumer hardware.
highlights: Targeted text normalisation and data balancing

title: Expense Tracker – MCP Server
desc: Built a natural-language personal-finance tracker that bridges Claude tool-use to a PostgreSQL backend over the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
contrib: Engineered multi-user schema with FastMCP tools for seamless conversational transaction logging and budget analysis.
highlights: Direct Claude AI integration via Model Context Protocol
PostgreSQL backend with parameterized safe queries
